scope: single-state behaviour-cloning + gated continuous-feedback probe; not convergence, not an algorithm comparison

exploration.note: teacher-forced log pi of each improved neighbour; the first divergent decision gives the per-sample probability the sampler needs to produce it

bc_only.note: all rules rank the same k candidates with the same forecast bank and the same budget shield; 'feasible_forecast' is the rule that matches the research question, 'training_label' is what the critic was fitted on, 'forecast_ignoring_budget' keeps the old (inconsistent) oracle column only as a contrast

bc_masac.note: all rules rank the same k candidates with the same forecast bank and the same budget shield; 'feasible_forecast' is the rule that matches the research question, 'training_label' is what the critic was fitted on, 'forecast_ignoring_budget' keeps the old (inconsistent) oracle column only as a contrast

truth_scope: executed truth on this block's 1 ms channel; read after all decisions, never used for training or selection
